ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (at times referred to as the "Agreement"), made as of the 7' day of January, 2026, by and between MATTICORE HOLDINGS LLC, New York limited liability company, having an address at 3234 White Plains Road, Bronx, New York 10467 (at times referred to herein as “Matticore Holdings"), and HARD REALTY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 487 East Main Street,Suite 164,Mount Kisco,NewYork 10549(at times referred toherein as“Hard Realty"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Matticore Holdings is the owners of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon,in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx,City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 3234 White Plains Road, Bronx, NewYork, anddesignatedasTaxLot15inBlock4596on theTaxMapof theCityof NewYork,Bronx County (the “"Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Land,” said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Building,” and the Parcel A Land and the Parcel A Building being herein collectively referred to as “Parcel A.” and the owner of Parcel A, and its successors and assigns, shall be referred to herein at times collectively as"ParcelAOwner"); WHEREAS, Hard Realty is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx, City and State of New York, generally known as and by the street address 3221 Cruger Avenue, Bronx, New York, and designated as Tax Lot 48 in Block 4596 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein collectively referred to as the “Parcel B Land,”said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the“Parcel B Building,”and the Parcel B Land, the Parcel B Building being herein collectively referred to as“Parcel B",and the owner of Parcel B, and its successors and assigns, shall be referred to herein at times as “Parcel B Owner”,and at times Parcel A Owner and Parcel WHEREAS,Parcel B Owner intends to construct a new building (said new building and any Rebuilding or replacements thereof,at times hereinafter referred to as the“New Developer Building") on Parcel B with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Parcel B under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if Parcel B were to be considered as a separate and independent zoninglot;
